features.name: Single-shot defensive firearm firing a large-bore shotgun round, retained in the Heavy Pistols category
Own art has substantial forward barrel/body, curved lower grip/body opening and a thin rearward member terminating in a transverse plate; preserve the thin member and open spaces

Assigned sole final reference reviewer inspected the actual raw pair, independent native foreground/masks, final2048 detail/clay teal images and overlay against the retained own EICHIROHATAMOTOII source-form authority. Substantial forward barrel/body, curved lower grip/thumb opening, actual trigger/guard opening, long thin rearward member and complete terminal transverse plate retain matching proportions and framing. Main muzzle geometry and upper structural recess remain. Tiny fastener-face/annular recesses, grip texture, side grooves, small panel channels, plate dimples and marks are filled into continuous smooth clay; major volumes and raised boundaries stay. Both large openings and the small rendered right-guard clearances remain open independently; native source/output topology unchanged per role. Whole object and clear margins, no cropped thin parts, no broad halo. Discarded native tiny foreground labels were guard-edge AA fringe, not separate subject parts; no false zero-matte counter claim. Common uniform crop/scale only, no warp or manual RGB retouch. Native1254square RGB originals were opaque; honestly resampled2048 references. Actual identity is the source-defined single-shot shotgun-round heavy pistol; generic weapon/taser boilerplate in the old clay prompt does not reclassify it as a taser. Reference-only approval, no geometry/client/production approval.
